title: Care Coordination Note: Strip Refills While the Customer Uses a CGM Program
content:
When a Blood Glucose Testing Supply Program customer also holds a Continuous Glucose Monitoring Supply Program, part of a test-strip refill's supply days may be supplied at a CGM backup rate instead of the order's daily rate.

**Note.** The supply days at the order's daily rate run only from the ship date to the CGM hold limit, never past the end of the supply days, when the customer's CGM program is on hold and that hold limit, the CGM hold start date plus the longest hold the CGM program's tier allows, falls after the ship date; they run only over the supply days after the CGM sensor supply ends when the customer's CGM program is active and its latest sensor refill, by its ship date plus its supply days, still covers days after the ship date; and otherwise they run over every supply day; the remaining supply days are supplied at the CGM backup rate of the tier's with-CGM allowance divided by 90 strips a day.

- The order's daily rate is the order's units per 30 days times the strips per billing unit, divided by 30.
- Days to the hold limit are the days from the ship date to that limit; days still covered by the sensor supply are the sensor refill's ship date plus its supply days, less the ship date.
- The strips of the two parts are added together before the refill's strips are turned into whole units.

| Tier | With-CGM allowance per 90 days | CGM backup rate, strips a day |
|---|---|---|
| Testing Supplies Self-Pay Program | 1200 | 13.33 |
| Testing Supplies Commercial HMO Program | 150 | 1.67 |
| Testing Supplies Commercial PPO Program | 150 | 1.67 |
| Testing Supplies Medicare Advantage Program | 300 | 3.33 |
| Testing Supplies Original Medicare Program | 300 | 3.33 |
| Testing Supplies Medicaid Program | 150 | 1.67 |

**Worked cases (hypothetical; order of 4 units per 30 days, 90 supply days, allowance with CGM of 300)**

- CGM program active, sensor supply covers 20 more days: 20 days at 300 divided by 90 give 66.67 strips; the other 70 days at the order's rate give 466.67 strips; together 533.33 strips, which is 10.67 units, rounded up to 11.
- CGM program on hold, its hold limit 40 days after the ship date: 40 days at the order's rate and 50 days at the backup rate.
- CGM program on hold with its hold limit already passed, or closed, or none held: all 90 days at the order's rate.
